comparison: Different attention mathematics; throughput comparison, not numerical equivalence.
exclusions: gate and coefficient generation, including sigmoid/tanh
projections, convolution, output normalization, and other model layers

input_distribution.common: upstream_inputs.kernel_inputs; unit Q/K, Gaussian V/cotangent, sigmoid beta/erase, negative log decay
input_distribution.gdn: unit Q/K; scale=1/sqrt(width); signed write is (2*FP32 beta-1) cast to BF16
input_distribution.mosaic_coefficients_description: Per-query FP32 Taylor coefficients, supplied as differentiable inputs; tanh excluded
input_distribution.softmax_and_mosaic: Q multiplied by width in FP32 before BF16 cast; scale=1/sqrt(width), giving order-one scores

memory: Compiler buffer estimates and allocator statistics, not isolated per-kernel measured peaks.

gdn_independent_tanh_jax_bridge.precision: BF16 public operands/output; GDN bridge promotes Q/K/V/gates/intermediates to FP32 and uses TF32x3

gdn_tied_sigmoid_jax_bridge.precision: BF16 public operands/output; GDN bridge promotes Q/K/V/gates/intermediates to FP32 and uses TF32x3

query_polynomial_cubic_mosaic.precision: BF16 Q/K/V/output; FP32 polynomial coefficients, scores and accumulators with three-part BF16 products

softmax_cudnn.precision: Stock JAX/cuDNN BF16 causal flash attention

scope: Attention forward or forward plus all input gradients; no scalar loss reduction.
timing: Compiled call plus host dispatch, synchronized after every call; each program compiles once.
